blocks.text: Your building access is all set, so you should not have to wait on anyone to get in next week. Facilities has you in the entry system under Ashley Williams, your badge is programmed for the suite and the after-hours door, and the elevator will read it for our floor without a call down to the desk. We had the garage list updated at the same time, so parking is covered as well.

If the badge does not read on your first morning, come find me and I will walk it down to facilities with you rather than leave you standing in the lobby. Let me know once you have tried it and I will close the ticket.
